column7: migrate-from-user created the machine identity and suspended the source user in two transactions, so a SetAccountState error reported failure with the identity deliberately kept (an informative partial success oracle (a) could not exempt). Both writes are now one transaction (migrate-user-to-machine-atomic-001), so the partial state no longer exists; the opScopedBestEffortTables entry post_projects_id_machine_identities_migrate_from_user_setaccountstate in server/faultops was dead after that and has been removed. Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
